summary: ☁️ **WeatherOverhaul** makes fair-weather clouds cast lighter shade, adds taller cumulus towers and smooths out the sky.
🛒 **TeleportCarts** improves cart shortcut diagnostics and destination placement.

bullets: Better cart shortcut diagnostics and destination placement.
Fair-weather clouds no longer darken the ground as much by day; overcast skies are unchanged.
Some fair-weather cumulus now grow into tall rounded towers, and high thin clouds lose the streaks from the sun.
Ashlands has only small gaps in the ash clouds instead of large open sky.
